title: Trial Comparing Tack Versus Histoacryl Mesh Fixation After Endoscopic TEP(Total Extraperitoneal) Repair for Bilateral Inguinal Hernia
brief_summary: This prospective randomized trial is performed to analyze the post-operative pain (acute and chronic) after endoscopic TEP repair after bilateral inguinal hernia repair.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients present with clinical bilateral inguinal hernias And feasible for general anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient preference for either fixation technique, refusal to participate, previous major lower abdominal surgery, concomitant surgical procedures other than hernia repair, and history of allergy to Histoacryl.
